## Blotato support agent

Ticket webhook in, classify as billing / how-to / technical, read the Blotato API, draft a reply, then hold it for a person.

Reads only:
- GET /v2/users/me/accounts
- GET /v2/posts/:postSubmissionId

This workflow never publishes, schedules, or removes a post.

Set the n8n environment variable BLOTATO_API_KEY. Leave it empty and the HTTP steps fail soft so the draft still comes back.
